resources.string: This part of Spoil Not for iPhone is on its way.
A new version of Spoil Not is ready
This copy of Spoil Not has no Firebase configuration.
Recipes your household saves in the Android app show up here, ready to cook, plan and shop from.
No saved recipes yet. Save some in the Android app, or plan something else above.

Spoil Not keeps only what it needs: your email and display name, your household\'s pantry, lists and recipes, this phone\'s notification token and time zone. Only members of your household can see household data. There are no ads, no analytics and no crash reports. You can export your data or delete your account at any time in Settings.
To get reminders on iPhone, add Spoil Not to your Home Screen: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and open it from there.
Turn them on in the iPhone\'s Settings, under Notifications, then Spoil Not.
This browser cannot show Spoil Not\'s reminders. On iPhone, add Spoil Not to the Home Screen from Safari.
